image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a circular aneroid barometer. The instrument features a brass or gold-colored metallic casing and a cream-colored dial face. The center of the dial has a decorative, embossed golden design resembling a sunburst or stylized figure. Black numerical markings indicate pressure values (e.g., 1020, 1030) along the outer ring, with smaller tick marks. A thin black pointer hand is visible near the bottom center. Text labels such as 'CHANGE' and weather descriptors are present but appear slightly distorted or illegible upon close inspection.
